summary: cto checked in 4 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Recommendation: keep the private-preview gate unchanged. Preparing an unsent permission request is technically safe and reversible, but it requires an explicit owner choice before any outreach. No public launch, credential change, data-flow expansion, monetization, or production change is authorized while rights, security, accuracy, attribution, measurement, and privacy gates remain incomplete.

Approve the four proposed SEO changes for the existing engineer queue. Each is isolated to one page, reversible, low-risk, and supported by supplied Search Console evidence. Require factual edits, pre/post snapshots, indexing and disclosure checks, and measurement only from available telemetry. Do not treat impressions, clicks, sessions, or conversions as revenue or causal lift.

Defer CRO tooling, affiliate-module expansion, and additional AI-intensive production work. Existing work is already measuring, execution backlog is materially larger than completed outcomes, and the supplied evidence does not support adoption, revenue, margin, or payback claims.

Approve bounded report-only reconciliation of contribution-margin inputs and AI spend exposure. These reports must align source windows, distinguish observed usage from avoidable or billable cost, preserve aggregate revenue as unattributed, and define control requirements without changing schedules, queues, models, credentials, billing, or production configuration.
